_comment: Relative paths are relative to this folder, so this works on any machine where the image folder and spreadsheet sit next to fish_annotator (e.g. ~/Desktop on the Mac, /home/student/Desktop on the Linux PC). Use absolute paths if they live elsewhere.
_comment_port: Port can also be set with: bash start.sh --port 9000  (or FA_PORT=9000). host 127.0.0.1 = only reachable through an SSH tunnel (recommended).
